title.narrative: THE PURPOSE OF THIS PROJECT IS TO SUPPORT A CONSERVATION EFFORT IN THE COUNTRY OF GUYANA BY WORKING WITH LOCALS TO STABILIZE AND THEN GROW THE POPULATION OF SUN PARAKEETS (ARATINGA SOLSTITIALIS) IN TH

description.narrative: This project is intended to conserve the sun parakeet by addressing the impacts of the illegal wildlife trade on the species and by educating local people about its conservation status and how they can help. Specific project activities include: (1) training and supporting the villagers to improve their capacity as parakeet conservationists; (2) studying and monitoring the species population dynamics and reproductive biology as little is known about this species in the wild and this knowledge is needed to protect them; (3) developing sustainable parrot conservation efforts through ecotourism strategies for local communities; (4) supporting education and awareness activities within the village area and on the national level; and (5) growing the capacity and networking of all of the various stakeholders involved in parrot conservation in Guyana by conducting a sun parakeet conservation workshop in Georgetown, developing online networking platforms, and drafting and disseminating a long-term conservation plan.
